## Lisbon 4-Day Trip Plan: Museums, Food, and a Beach Break
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3c/Beach_near_Lisbon_Portugal%2C_1994..jpg Alt=Lisbon 4-Day Trip Plan: Museums, Food, and a Beach Break, Lisbon, Portugal

A relaxed 4-day Lisbon plan for 2 adults, paced for sightseeing without overpacking the days. I’ve kept the budget target under **€1,800 total excluding flights** and assumed mid-range dining, public transit, and one comfortable beach outing.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Cost Plan

### Day 1: Historic Lisbon + Baixa Food Introduction
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and do an easy walk through **Baixa, Rossio, and Chiado**.
- Afternoon: Visit **MUDE** or the **National Museum of Contemporary Art** if you want a lighter museum start.
- Evening: Join a **guided food tour** in central Lisbon for pastries, petiscos, and local wine.

Estimated cost for 2: **€280–€360**
- Hotel: €170–€230
- Food tour: €80–€120
- Meals/transit/snacks: €30–€50

### Day 2: Belém Museums + Riverside Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Head to **Belém** for **Jerónimos Monastery** and the **Coach Museum**.
- Afternoon: Walk the riverside, stop at **Pastéis de Belém**, and visit the **MAAT** if you want a modern-art option.
- Evening: Casual dinner near Cais do Sodré or back in central Lisbon.

Estimated cost for 2: **€240–€330**
- Hotel: €170–€230
- Tickets: €25–€50
- Food/transit: €45–€50

### Day 3: Beach Day in Cascais or Carcavelos
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Take the train to **Cascais** for a relaxed seaside start; choose **Carcavelos** if you want a simpler beach day.
- Afternoon: Beach time, promenade walk, and a long lunch by the water.
- Evening: Return to Lisbon for a light dinner and an early night.

Estimated cost for 2: **€190–€280**
- Hotel: €170–€230
- Train/transit: €10–€20
- Food/drinks: €40–€70

### Day 4: Alfama, Tile Museum, and Final Meal
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg
- Morning: Explore **Alfama** on foot, with viewpoints and slow wandering.
- Afternoon: Visit the **National Tile Museum** or **Fado Museum** depending on your interest.
- Evening: End with a final dinner in a neighborhood you liked most.

Estimated cost for 2: **€240–€340**
- Hotel: €170–€230
- Tickets: €15–€30
- Food/transit: €55–€80

### Budget Check for the Full Trip
| Category | Estimated Total |
|---|---:|
| Hotel, 4 nights | €680–€920 |
| Food and drinks | €220–€360 |
| Museums and activities | €120–€220 |
| Local transit and taxis | €40–€90 |
| Beach day extras | €20–€40 |
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e1/Bundesarchiv_Bild_134-A299%2C_Tsingtau%2C_Erste_deutsche_B%C3%A4ckerei.jpg Alt=| Beach day extras | €20–€40 |, Lisbon, Portugal
| Contingency | €100–€150 |
| **Trip total** | **€1,180–€1,780** |

## Packing List for Early Autumn in Lisbon

Lisbon in mid-September is usually warm in the day, cooler at night, and comfortable for walking.

- 4–5 light tops
- 2–3 bottoms you can mix and match
- 1 light jacket or cardigan
- Comfortable walking shoes with grip
- Sandals or casual evening shoes
- Swimwear and a quick-dry towel for the beach day
- Sunglasses, hat, and sunscreen
- Small day bag or crossbody bag
- Reusable water bottle
- Light rain layer, just in case
- Phone charger and power bank
- Any motion-sickness meds if you plan tram or hill-heavy walks
